description:
Whether you're getting into AI or training for a fall marathon, you can find likeminded people on Luma. Join a paper reading or run club to get one step closer to your goals.

Luma powers millions of events around the world. So whether you're into knitting or kiting, you'll be able to find something to join.

If you're hosting an event, you can use this connector to help keep track of and manage your upcoming events.
